data.define: To decide what to do as things happen.

misuse.text: Don't say 'play it by ear' for a big wedding.

publish.title: What does "play it by ear" mean?
publish.value: Play it by ear = Decide later, no fixed plan. Example: "Let's play it by ear." (casual English).
